reminders.name: Reminders and tray
reminders.description: A daily notification when cards are waiting (never on days you already studied), and the option to keep the app in the system tray.

enabled.label: Daily reminder
enabled.description: When on, a notification comes at your chosen time if cards are waiting; not on days you already studied.

minute_of_day.label: Reminder time
minute_of_day.description: The time the notification comes (this computer's clock).

weekdays.label: Reminder days
weekdays.description: Reminders only come on the chosen days.

keep_in_tray.label: Keep running in the tray
keep_in_tray.description: When on, closing the window only hides it: the app keeps running in the system tray and reminders keep coming. When off, closing the window quits the app.

reminders.heading: Reminders
reminders.intro: One notification a day so you don't forget to study: choose the time and the days here.
reminders.keep_in_tray: Closing the window keeps the app in the tray
reminders.studied: You already studied today: no reminder today.
reminders.notification: {total, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} are waiting for you today ({due} due, {new} new).
reminders.time_hint: The time the notification comes (this computer's clock). If the app is not open then, it still reminds you when you open it within the next 3 hours.
reminders.test_hint: Check right now that notifications reach you. If nothing shows, allow Flashcard in your system's notification settings.
reminders.daily_desc: The notification only comes when cards are waiting and you have not studied yet that day; at most once a day.
reminders.tray_desc: For reminders to come, the app has to keep running in the background.

desc.enabled: When on, a notification comes at your chosen time if cards are waiting. Not on days you already studied or when nothing is waiting.
desc.days: Reminders only come on the chosen days. Want weekends off? Turn off Sat and Sun.
desc.keep_in_tray: When on, closing the window only hides it; the app keeps running in the tray next to the clock and reminders come. When off, closing the window quits the app and no reminder comes that day.

example.enabled: At {time} a notification says “{total, plural, one {# card is} other {# cards are}} waiting for you today”.
